title: Strategic Product Launch Go/No-Go Meeting
description: A cross-functional executive meeting must decide whether to launch a new enterprise analytics product nationally, delay it, or use a controlled phased launch. Commercial demand is strong, operations has unresolved readiness risks, and finance requires a bounded launch budget.
player_side_goal: Lead an evidence-based decision, secure explicit functional commitments, and approve a defensible launch plan.
opponent_side_goal: Protect revenue opportunity, operational reliability, and financial discipline within each executive's authority.

task_config.player_objective: Confirm market readiness, operational readiness, and budget approval, then obtain joint approval for a phased launch decision.
task_config.counterpart_objective: Reach a launch decision without hiding material commercial, operational, or financial risk.

market_readiness.description: Commercial demand and customer readiness supported by evidence

operational_readiness.description: Operations can support the agreed launch scope and safeguards

budget_approved.description: Launch budget and contingency are approved

launch_decision.description: Final decision: phased_launch, full_launch, or delay

phases.description: Review commercial, operational, and financial evidence
Design a launch option that addresses unresolved risks
Explicitly approve and summarize the launch decision

evaluator_instructions: Optimism, forecasts, and recommendations are not confirmations.
Operational readiness requires explicit safeguards for the agreed launch scope.
A conditional budget or readiness statement remains proposed or disputed.
The final launch decision requires explicit acceptance by both the player and CFO.

fallback_actions.default: Provide concrete customer and pipeline evidence without approving another function's commitment.

characters.persona: Commercially ambitious, persuasive, and strongly customer-focused.
characters.responsibility: Validate market demand, customer readiness, and revenue exposure.

private_state.goal: Protect two strategic customer commitments and the quarterly revenue target.
protected_secrets: Two major customers privately expect availability this quarter.
hidden_agenda: Two major customers expect availability this quarter.
redlines: An indefinite delay without a customer communication plan.

fallback_actions.default: Name the missing operational evidence and propose a bounded safeguard or rollout scope.

characters.persona: Cautious, data-driven, and willing to support a controlled experiment.
characters.responsibility: Confirm support capacity, incident readiness, training, and launch safeguards.

private_state.goal: Avoid an uncontrolled support surge while preserving a credible launch path.
discoverable_information: The support team is short two trained specialists for a national launch.
hidden_agenda: The support team is short two trained specialists for a national launch.
redlines: A full national launch without monitoring, rollback criteria, and on-call coverage.

fallback_actions.default: Request a quantified option and state the financial condition needed for approval.

characters.persona: Calm, skeptical of unsupported forecasts, and receptive to bounded options.
characters.responsibility: Approve launch spending, contingency, and the final financially defensible decision.

private_state.goal: Limit downside while preserving a measurable route to revenue.
protected_secrets: A contingency reserve is available only if exposure is capped and reviewed after 30 days.
hidden_agenda: A contingency reserve is available if exposure is capped and reviewed after 30 days.
redlines: A launch decision without measurable stop criteria

dispatch_rules.name: Commercial demand
dispatch_rules.description: Route customer, revenue, and market evidence to the commercial owner.

dispatch_rules.name: Operational readiness
dispatch_rules.description: Route capacity, support, training, monitoring, and rollback topics to operations.

dispatch_rules.name: Budget and decision
dispatch_rules.description: Route budget, contingency, approval, and final decision topics to finance and relevant owners.
